correctness.rationale: Encode a maximal independent set on the 2n-vertex Möbius ladder as rung states U,V,0 with boundary twist U↔V after n rungs. Independence forces adjacent occupied states to differ; domination of both vertices on an empty rung forces its neighbors occupied and of opposite types. Thus zeros never adjacent, the j occupied states strictly alternate around the twisted cycle, and j is odd. Conversely every n-periodic cyclic pattern with j odd occupied positions and isolated empty positions lifts in exactly 2 ways and all are maximal independent. Marking an occupied rung counts n/j*binom(j,n−j) binary cyclic patterns; the 2 lifts give coefficient 2n/j*binom(j,n−j). The generating function follows 2t∂_t artanh(zt(1+t)) and deleting n=1,2. Independent brute force over all 2^(2n) labeled vertex subsets for every n=3..9 compared each graded coefficient exactly, including n=9 {5:18,7:54,9:2}; source verifier independently reports n=3..10 and numerical formula checks through n=200. Infinite identity is a bijection proof, not finite extrapolation.
